# rt/path

> File paths as strings: joining them and taking them apart.

truck [rt](../rt.md) · [source](../../../registry/rt/path.pkg)

```
print path_join("registry", "std/if.pkg")   // registry/std/if.pkg
print path_dir("registry/std/if.pkg")       // registry/std
print path_base("registry/std/if.pkg")      // if.pkg
print path_ext("registry/std/if.pkg")       // .pkg
```

| function | does |
|---|---|
| `path_join(a: str, b: str) -> str` | `a/b`, with one `/` between; `b` if it is absolute or `a` is empty |
| `path_dir(p: str) -> str` | everything before the last `/`: `"."` if there is none, `"/"` for a file at the root |
| `path_base(p: str) -> str` | everything after the last `/`, ignoring trailing slashes |
| `path_ext(p: str) -> str` | the base's extension, with its dot (`".pkg"`); `""` if there is none, or for a name like `.profile` |
| `path_is_abs(p: str) -> bool` | does `p` start with `/` |

They work on text only: nothing touches the file system, and `..` and
`.` are left as they are.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
fn path_is_abs(p: str) -> bool
  return len(p) > 0 && p[0] == '/'
end

fn path_join(a: str, b: str) -> str
  if a == "" || path_is_abs(b)
    return b
  end
  if b == ""
    return a
  end
  if a[len(a) - 1] == '/'
    return str_concat(a, b)
  end
  return str_concat(str_concat(a, "/"), b)
end

// path_trim drops trailing slashes, but keeps "/" itself
fn path_trim(p: str) -> str
  let n = len(p)
  while n > 1 && p[n - 1] == '/'
    n = n - 1
  end
  return str_slice(p, 0, n)
end

fn path_last_slash(p: str) -> int
  let i = len(p) - 1
  while i >= 0 && p[i] != '/'
    i = i - 1
  end
  return i
end

fn path_dir(p: str) -> str
  let t = path_trim(p)
  let i = path_last_slash(t)
  if i < 0
    return "."
  elif i == 0
    return "/"
  end
  return path_trim(str_slice(t, 0, i))
end

fn path_base(p: str) -> str
  let t = path_trim(p)
  if t == "/"
    return "/"
  end
  return str_slice(t, path_last_slash(t) + 1, len(t))
end

fn path_ext(p: str) -> str
  let b = path_base(p)
  let i = len(b) - 1
  while i > 0 && b[i] != '.'
    i = i - 1
  end
  if i <= 0
    return ""
  end
  return str_slice(b, i, len(b))
end
```
